question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: On the trailing-four-quarter basis cash runs ahead of earnings: operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}, above the prior fiscal year's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and the three-year-earlier low of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}, negative as in the two prior fiscal years ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value} and {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value}) and far below the positive {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value} of 2022. Three qualifications. First, the second quarter on its own: operating cash flow was {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}, a change of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} against the first quarter and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct} against the year-earlier quarter, while quarterly net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}; the MD&A explains only the six-month total, so the quarter's divergence has no stated cause. Second, the trailing strength rests on customer prepayment: current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier, and the MD&A attributes the half's deferred-revenue build first to contracts with acceptance terms — cash received before revenue is earned, so the cash is real but the matching revenue is still to be recognized. Third, working capital absorbs a growing share of earnings: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income.value|pct} of trailing net income), inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income.value|pct}), while payables supplied only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value}; trade working capital grew {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital.value}, and other current assets (deferred cost of goods sold and prepaids) absorbed more cash than a year earlier. Articulation is clean for receivables and inventory (gaps of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value} and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value}); payables show a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap.value}, small and consistent with non-cash items such as unpaid capital spending, but the notes do not explain it. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}, well below one: quarterly net income has risen almost every quarter while quarterly operating cash flow has swung widely, so income is far smoother than the cash behind it.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash conversion is strong against the company's own history, but the quarter's cash fell while income rose, income is far smoother than cash, and the surplus is built on acceptance-term prepayments and absorbed by rising receivables and inventory

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivable days for the quarter are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, the highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} in the first quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a year earlier; receivables over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue.value}, also the highest; on the annual table 2025 receivable days of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} were well above 2024's {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}. The trailing average-balance measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value}. The year-over-year receivables rise roughly tracked trailing revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct}, so the MD&A's attribution to higher billings is not contradicted year on year, but the sequential climb coincides with a liquidity paragraph newly disclosing that certain large customer arrangements carry extended payment terms — a cause the operating-cash-flow paragraph does not mention. Contract liabilities move with revenue, not against it: the current balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} a year earlier, and the ratio to quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}, second highest of six, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value} but above the year-earlier {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}. The substantive wording change is the MD&A's new account of customer trials and acceptance periods, especially in AI Ethernet, as the driver of both evaluation inventory and product deferred revenue, with an explicit warning of quarterly revenue variability; this is a new judgment area (acceptance-based recognition timing), and the tagged revenue recognized out of the opening contract-liability balance roughly tripled against the year-earlier quarter, so a rising share of each quarter's revenue is released from deferrals on acceptance. Unbilled product remaining performance obligations also rose against the prior quarter and year end. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested: the record derives no fourth quarter. Bill-and-hold, principal-versus-agent and standalone-selling-price changes: nothing found in either report. The 8-K and 10-Q agree on quarterly revenue.
revenue_recognition.verdict: elevated attention: receivable days at a six-quarter high alongside newly disclosed extended payment terms, and revenue increasingly released from acceptance-term deferrals whose timing management itself calls variable

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The three reserve-thinning tests cannot be run from the record: the allowance for credit losses carries no row for the current balance date, no inventory valuation reserve is tagged in any period, and no warranty accrual is tagged in any period; the calculator's inventory_reserve, bad_debt_allowance and warranty_accrual fields are all missing. What is visible points the other way from thinning but leaves a gap: the inventory write-down tagged for 2025 was below both 2024 and 2023, no write-down fact exists for 2026, and yet the MD&A now warns of a heightened risk of excess or obsolete inventory and supplier liability charges while raw materials and evaluation inventory rose sharply against year end. Goodwill: the VeloCloud allocation is still described as preliminary and goodwill did not change in the half; no discount-rate or growth assumption is disclosed in a 10-Q. The effective tax rate is rising, not falling — the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate.value|pct}, and the tax note attributes the quarterly increase to lower tax benefits from equity-based compensation — so no discrete item or valuation-allowance release lifts earnings; the deferred tax benefit in the cash-flow reconciliation is smaller than a year earlier and is attributed to deferred revenue. One estimate change is favourable to future cash rather than income: the remaining campus construction spend was lowered. One disclosure narrowed as the underlying number worsened: the unrealized-loss table dropped its twelve-months-or-greater and total columns and added a sentence that such positions were not material, while gross unrealized losses on debt securities rose many-fold against year end and other comprehensive income turned negative; the notes still state no credit losses and an intent to hold.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: no income-raising estimate change found in GAAP figures, but the reserve ratios are untestable, the 2025 write-down fell while management's stated obsolescence risk rose, and securities-loss disclosure narrowed as losses grew

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalized software or development cost is tagged in any period; research and development is expensed, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value} over the trailing four quarters, with the six-month figure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value} a year earlier, attributed to personnel and new-product-introduction costs. The deferral that is growing is deferred cost of goods sold inside prepaid and other current assets: the tagged current deferred-cost balance rose against year end and is several times its level at the end of 2024, and the note attributes it to a corresponding increase in deferred product revenue — matched deferral, benign while acceptance is obtained, but it becomes an inventory write-down if trials fail, as the MD&A itself says. Soft assets are at a record share: {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} of total assets, the highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} two years earlier, and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} for 2025, the highest of five years; the driver is marketable securities ({terms.balances_now.short_term_investments.value}) plus deferred costs, receivables and inventory rather than intangibles. Non-recurring items: neither report names a non-recurring charge, so nothing recurs. The non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be trended from the record; the release prints a quarterly gap made of share-based compensation, intangible amortization and tax effects, and — the substantive point — the company changed its non-GAAP tax method from the fourth quarter of 2025 and recast prior periods, which raised the year-earlier non-GAAP net income; the headline non-GAAP EPS growth is measured against that recast base, while GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}. Share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}, rising, with grant-date fair values of new units about double the prior nonvested pool, so the GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap will widen as those units vest.
cost_deferral.verdict: no development-cost capitalization; deferred cost of goods sold and soft-asset share at record levels but matched to deferred revenue and securities; the non-GAAP comparison base was recast upward

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: the proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables field is not in the calculator (untagged) and neither report mentions a sale programme — nothing found. Supplier finance: the obligation field is not in the calculator (untagged) and the notes carry no programme — nothing found. Classification shifting between operating and investing: none identified; the only new lines are an other-investing outflow and a small other-financing outflow, and the 10-K and 10-Q tag the same capital-spending line under different concepts, which is a tagging inconsistency rather than a classification change. Purchase obligations: the calculator's unconditional_purchase_obligations field is missing, but the note states non-cancellable commitments not recorded on the balance sheet that are larger than the entire trailing four quarters' cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue.value}, up against both the prior quarter and year end, with the portion beyond twelve months shrinking; the same note dropped the sentence describing what the obligations encompass, so comparability of the totals across quarters is open. Leases: no current operating-lease liability is in the record (the calculator fell back to a 2024 balance); nothing in the notes. Guarantees: the maximum-exposure field is untagged and the guarantees text is unchanged standing language. Variable-interest entities: nothing found; the MD&A still states no off-balance-sheet arrangements. Debt is {terms.debt_now.value}. Two timing items flatter the half's operating cash flow: income tax payables rose, which the MD&A itself calls related to timing of payments and which reverses when paid, and the financing paragraph cites taxes paid under equity incentive and stock repurchase plans in a half with no repurchases. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} is treated as a real cost: simple free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value} and the quality-adjusted figure after share-based compensation is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}. Buybacks stopped: trailing repurchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value} with none in the half, and cash plus short-term investments reached {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now.value}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no factoring, supplier finance or classification shift found; off-balance-sheet purchase commitments are large, rising and now less clearly scoped; a tax-payable timing inflow helps the half's cash

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Formal signals are clean: the notes reader lists no auditor-change, non-reliance or officer-departure item codes in the window since the prior 10-Q, no late-filing notification exists on or before the cutoff, the controls item concludes disclosure controls effective with no material change in internal control, and no critical audit matters arise in a 10-Q (the auditor's report is not in the input). One point the two readers leave open: the numbers reader's longer item-code list includes an officer-change code and a charter-amendment code with no body in either report, so whether a finance-function change occurred earlier in the year cannot be settled here. Quiet restatement: the one superseded prior-period fact compared (year-end cash) carries the same value in both filings, and no restatement trace exists; the only recast is non-GAAP, disclosed in the release. Tagging: the 10-K reports capital spending under one concept and the 10-Qs under another for the same line, including the comparative periods — a consistency lapse that the calculator notes and that does not change the amounts. Insider arrangements: the chief financial officer modified her rule-based trading plan to sell performance-unit shares, and a director adopted one, both in the quarter in which buybacks were nil; neither is a departure. Related parties, subsidiary-list changes and comment letters: nothing in the input (no related-party note item, exhibits and comment correspondence not provided).
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: clean on auditor, controls, timeliness and restatement; minor tagging inconsistency, an unresolved officer-change code outside the window, and insider selling plans at the finance chief and board level

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The earnings-release 8-K and the 10-Q carry the same quarterly revenue, the same quarterly net income and the same current deferred revenue, and both show the year-over-year gross-margin decline; the release matches the filing. Of the forty notes items carrying an expected direction, the numbers confirm twenty-three, contradict none outright, and leave seventeen unresolved — the unresolved ones being forward-looking outlook levels, conditional risk statements, disclosure-wording changes with no amount, insider trading plans, and two cross-document tensions: the chief financial officer's quoted EPS growth figure names no basis while GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}, and the release's broad-based growth language sits beside the 10-Q's attribution of the gross-margin decline to large end customers with higher discounts. The one prose-versus-prose inconsistency inside the 10-Q is the receivables cause: the liquidity paragraph names extended payment terms for large customers, the operating-cash-flow paragraph names only higher billings. The next-quarter non-GAAP operating-margin range the release gives sits below the margin just reported, which the numbers reader records as a downward direction.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: release and filing agree on every headline figure; most directional claims are confirmed by the numbers; the open items are forward statements and two basis-of-comparison questions

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory.value} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory.value} a year earlier; trailing inventory days are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value} and the quarterly figure {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} is the lowest of six quarters (year earlier {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}) because cost of revenue grew faster than stock — but the mix moved toward risk: raw materials and evaluation inventory each rose sharply against year end, the 2025 write-down fell against both prior years, no 2026 write-down is tagged, no reserve is tagged, and management now warns of heightened excess-and-obsolete risk. Purchase commitments in excess of need: the stated non-cancellable commitments due within twelve months exceed the whole trailing four quarters' cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue.value}, rose against the prior quarter and year end, and management says they were raised to secure memory and silicon supply and will raise working-capital requirements; with the scope sentence removed from the note, this is a finding. Customer concentration: the record's facts are annual — in 2025 one reseller took {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} of revenue (up from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in 2024 and {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in 2023) and another {concentration.facts.5.value|pct}, while a single reseller held {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} of receivables at the 2025 year end after another held {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} at the 2024 year end; no quarterly concentration fact exists for this quarter, and the extended payment terms are disclosed for large customers. Channel stuffing: the sales are through resellers, receivable days are at a six-quarter high, evaluation inventory at customers is rising and acceptance-term deferrals are growing; the accounting response is conservative (revenue is deferred until acceptance and released later), so no stuffing of recognized revenue is visible, but shipped-not-accepted product is at a record and management itself flags return and write-down risk. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found — no related-party item, no investment in a customer disclosed; the only unexplained line is a new other-investing outflow with no note describing it.
industry_lens.verdict: inventory and commitment build with concentrated resellers and shipped-not-accepted product at a record; obsolescence reserve invisible; no stuffing of recognized revenue or circular dealing found

anomalies.name_ko: 분기 매출 중 기초 이연수익에서 인식되는 비중 증가
anomalies.what: Revenue recognized out of the opening contract-liability balance roughly tripled against the year-earlier quarter, so each quarter's revenue depends increasingly on acceptance timing rather than shipment.

anomalies.name: Evaluation inventory at customers at a record
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 평가용 재고 사상 최대
anomalies.what: Finished goods held as evaluation inventory rose against year end and each prior date in the record; this is shipped product whose revenue is not recognized and which management says may be returned.

anomalies.name: Inventory write-down fell in 2025 while management now flags heightened obsolescence risk
anomalies.name_ko: 2025년 재고 평가손실 감소, 그러나 진부화 위험 경고는 강화
anomalies.what: The 2025 write-down was below 2024 and 2023, no 2026 write-down is tagged and no reserve is tagged, while the MD&A adds a heightened risk of excess or obsolete inventory and supplier liability charges; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory.value}.

anomalies.name: Allowance, inventory reserve and warranty reserve cannot be tested
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금·재고평가충당금·보증충당금 비율 검증 불가
anomalies.what: No current allowance row, no inventory valuation reserve and no warranty accrual is tagged, so none of the three thinning tests can be run against history.

anomalies.name: Securities loss-aging disclosure narrowed as unrealized losses grew
anomalies.name_ko: 미실현손실 급증에도 손실 경과기간 공시는 축소
anomalies.what: The twelve-months-or-greater and total columns were dropped and replaced by a not-material sentence while gross unrealized losses rose many-fold against year end and accumulated other comprehensive income turned negative; short-term investments are {terms.balances_now.short_term_investments.value}.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate rising, not falling
anomalies.name_ko: 유효세율 상승
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate.value|pct} and the quarterly rate rose against the year-earlier quarter because equity-compensation tax benefits fell; adverse to earnings, not a sign of discretionary tax relief.

anomalies.name: Remaining campus construction estimate lowered
anomalies.name_ko: 캠퍼스 건설 잔여 투자 추정치 하향
anomalies.what: The remaining spend estimate for the Santa Clara building was lowered against the prior 10-Q with completion still expected by the end of 2026; trailing capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure.value}.

anomalies.name: Deferred cost of goods sold rising with product deferrals
anomalies.name_ko: 이연 매출원가가 제품 이연수익과 함께 증가
anomalies.what: Current deferred costs rose against year end and are several times the level at the end of 2024; the note ties the rise to deferred product revenue, so the deferral is matched, but it converts to a write-down if acceptance fails.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at the highest point in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 비현금·비유형 자산 비중 사상 최고
anomalies.what: Soft assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} of total assets, the highest of six quarters and above {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} for 2025; the driver is marketable securities and deferred costs rather than intangibles.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP tax method change recast the prior-year base upward
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 세금 산정 방식 변경으로 전년 비교치 상향 재산정
anomalies.what: From the fourth quarter of 2025 the company keeps indirect stock-award tax effects in non-GAAP results and recast prior periods, raising year-earlier non-GAAP net income; the headline non-GAAP EPS growth uses that base while GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising and grant values doubled
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비 증가, 신규 부여 공정가치 두 배
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}; the quarterly charge rose against the year-earlier quarter and new units carry roughly double the grant-date value of the prior nonvested pool, so the GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap will widen.

anomalies.name: Off-balance-sheet purchase commitments exceed a year's cost of revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 부외 구매약정이 연간 매출원가를 초과
anomalies.what: Non-cancellable commitments due within twelve months, as the note states them, are larger than the trailing four quarters' cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue.value} and rose against the prior quarter and year end; management says they were raised for AI deployment and memory and silicon supply.

anomalies.name: Purchase-obligation scope sentence removed from the note
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정 범위 설명 문장 삭제
anomalies.what: The sentence saying obligations also encompass software licences, property and equipment and other corporate goods was dropped; whether the total now excludes those categories is not said, so the quarter-to-quarter comparison of commitment totals is open.

anomalies.name: Income tax payable build is a timing inflow that reverses
anomalies.name_ko: 법인세 미지급금 증가는 지급 시 되돌아가는 일시 유입
anomalies.what: The six-month rise in income taxes payable, larger than a year earlier, lifted operating cash flow; the MD&A itself calls it related to timing of payments. No calculator field carries the amount, so no adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Financing paragraph cites repurchase-plan taxes in a half with no repurchases
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입이 없는 반기에 매입 관련 세금 문구 등장
anomalies.what: Repurchases for the six months are nil and trailing repurchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value}, yet the financing paragraph describes taxes paid under equity incentive and stock repurchase plans; likely carried-over wording, but the amount is not in the record.

anomalies.name: New other-investing outflow with no note
anomalies.name_ko: 설명 없는 신규 기타 투자활동 유출
anomalies.what: An other-investing outflow appears for the six months against nil a year earlier and no notes item describes it; acquisitions over the trailing four quarters are {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}, so it is not a business purchase.

anomalies.name: Share repurchases stopped while cash accumulates
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입 중단, 현금 축적
anomalies.what: No shares were repurchased in the half against substantial repurchases a year earlier; cash plus short-term investments is {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now.value} with debt of {terms.debt_now.value}.

anomalies.name: Capital spending tagged under different concepts in the 10-K and 10-Q
anomalies.name_ko: 10-K와 10-Q의 설비투자 태그 불일치
anomalies.what: The 10-K uses one concept and the 10-Qs another for the same line, including comparatives; amounts are unaffected but the calculator must splice tags to build trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}.

anomalies.name: Chief financial officer modified and a director adopted selling plans
anomalies.name_ko: CFO 매도 계획 수정 및 이사 매도 계획 신설
anomalies.what: In the quarter the finance chief modified her plan to sell performance-unit shares and a director adopted a selling plan, while the company repurchased no shares; neither is a departure and no number bears on them.

anomalies.name: Quoted EPS growth names no GAAP or non-GAAP basis
anomalies.name_ko: 인용된 EPS 성장률의 기준(GAAP/비GAAP) 미표시
anomalies.what: The finance chief's quote gives an EPS growth figure without basis; GAAP net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}, below the quoted figure, pointing to the recast non-GAAP basis.

anomalies.name: Release calls growth broad-based; 10-Q attributes margin decline to large-customer discounts
anomalies.name_ko: 보도자료의 '광범위한 성장'과 10-Q의 대형고객 할인 설명 간 긴장
anomalies.what: Growth was broad by region, but gross margin fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} on large-customer discounts and the latest annual facts show one reseller at {concentration.facts.6.value|pct} of revenue; the two documents describe the customer make-up differently.

anomalies.name: Next-quarter non-GAAP margin outlook below the margin just reported
anomalies.name_ko: 다음 분기 비GAAP 영업이익률 전망이 직전 실적을 하회
anomalies.what: The release's outlook range sits below the non-GAAP operating margin just reported, and is given without a GAAP reconciliation; trailing GAAP operating margin is {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct}.

anomalies.name: Over half of year-end receivables with a single reseller
anomalies.name_ko: 연말 매출채권의 절반 이상이 단일 리셀러에 집중
anomalies.what: At the 2025 year end one reseller held {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} of receivables and at the 2024 year end another held {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}; revenue share of the largest reseller rose to {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}; no quarterly fact exists for this quarter, and extended payment terms are disclosed for large customers.

anomalies.name: Raw materials inventory build
anomalies.name_ko: 원재료 재고 급증
anomalies.what: Raw materials rose sharply against year end while total inventory reached {terms.balances_now.inventory.value}; management attributes the build to new products and tightening memory and silicon supply.

anomalies.name: Inventory days fell while the balance rose
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 금액은 늘었지만 재고일수는 감소
anomalies.what: Quarterly inventory days of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} are the lowest of six quarters and the trailing figure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, because cost of revenue grew faster than stock; management's elevated-inventory language refers to dollars.

adjustments.name: Receivables growth tied to extended payment terms for large customers
adjustments.quote: our working capital and operating cash flows may experience timing differences as a result of certain large customer arrangements that include extended payment terms.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 기준 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}로 자사 과거보다 높고 발생액 비율도 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}로 음수이지만, 이번 분기만 보면 영업현금흐름이 전분기 대비 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter.value|pct} 변동한 반면 순이익은 전년 동기 대비 {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct} 늘었습니다. 현금 초과분은 검수 조건 선수금(이연수익 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value})에 기대고 있고, 이익의 변동성은 현금보다 훨씬 작습니다({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}).
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출채권 회수일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 최고이며, 같은 시기에 대형 고객 연장 결제조건이 새로 공시되었습니다. 고객 시험과 검수 조건으로 이연된 매출이 늘어 매출 인식 시점이 검수 여부에 더 좌우되고 있습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손·재고·보증 충당금 비율은 태그가 없어 검증할 수 없습니다. 2025년 재고 평가손실은 전년보다 줄었는데 경영진은 진부화 위험이 커졌다고 경고하고, 유효세율은 {tax_rate.effective_rate.value|pct}로 오르는 중이어서 세금으로 이익을 부풀린 흔적은 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value}는 전액 비용 처리됩니다. 이연 매출원가와 비현금성 자산 비중({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct})이 사상 최고이며, 비GAAP 세금 산정 방식 변경으로 전년 비교치가 상향 재산정되었습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 발견되지 않았습니다. 부외 구매약정은 최근 네 분기 매출원가 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue.value}보다 크고 계속 늘고 있으며, 약정 범위 설명 문장이 삭제되었습니다. 주식보상비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}를 차감한 조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}입니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 변경, 중요한 취약점, 지연 제출, 재작성은 없습니다. 10-K와 10-Q의 설비투자 태그가 다르고, CFO와 이사가 분기 중 주식 매도 계획을 수정·신설했습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표와 10-Q의 분기 매출, 순이익, 이연수익은 일치합니다. 공시 문장 대부분은 숫자로 확인되었고, CFO 인용문의 EPS 성장률 기준 미표시와 '광범위한 성장' 대 대형고객 할인 설명의 차이는 미해결로 남았습니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고는 {terms.balances_now.inventory.value}로 늘었지만 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 줄었고, 원재료와 평가용 재고가 급증했습니다. 2025년 한 리셀러가 매출의 {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}, 다른 리셀러가 매출채권의 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}를 차지해 집중도가 높으며, 순환 거래나 고객 투자 징후는 없습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
